title: Drainage-v1 frozen-scope authority reconciliation after F-PM15

finding.reason: F-PM13 defines exactly three closure blockers: G1 runtime composition, G2 transaction/mass/restart/MultiSWAP/diagnostics, and G3 canonical admission/preservation. Its binding F-PM08 architecture rule says process code may not mutate solver Jacobian internals. Its minimal closure route requires runtime composition, end-to-end independent qualification and F-CI admission/preservation, but does not require fully implicit drainage coupling. Historical F-VQ statements that fully implicit/Jacobian coupling was not qualified are therefore scope nonclaims, not frozen Drainage-v1 exit requirements. F-PM15 incorrectly promoted such a nonclaim to a new completion blocker.

next_required_step: Run a fresh F-PM13-class completion audit on current canonical using the exact unchanged F-PM13 denominator and exit criteria. Credit only evidence that closes original G1, G2 and G3. Do not add fully implicit coupling to Drainage-v1 unless a separate future model-evolution authority explicitly changes scope.
nonclaims: F-PM17 does not itself emit the final Drainage-v1 100-percent completion claim.
F-PM17 does not invalidate the useful evidence gathered by F-PM15 for G2/G3 preservation; it corrects only the extra G1R scope inference.
F-PM17 does not qualify or reject fully implicit drainage as future model evolution.
